استشظن (form X)
# اِسْتَشَظْنَ (istašaẓna) /is.ta.ʃaðˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَشَاظَ (istašāẓa)
# اُسْتُشِظْنَ (ustušiẓna) /us.tu.ʃiðˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَشَاظَ (istašāẓa)
# اِسْتَشِظْنَ (istašiẓna) /is.ta.ʃiðˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَشَاظَ (istašāẓa)
